look_here_first: Inspect the intact umbel spathe: usually 3–4 bracts with 3–7 veins each. Check flowers versus aerial bulbils; their absence does not exclude this variable species.

project_inclusion.learner_admission_basis: Approved Master Plant Pool row 34; 2026-10-07 taxonomy/diagnostic review
project_inclusion.range_basis: Texas native at state level; three target-zone counties not yet verified.

morphology_keys.leaves: Basal linear leaves 20–50 cm long, 1–7 mm wide.
morphology_keys.umbel: Loose cluster with 0–60 flowers; bulbils often present, but variable.

comparisons.key_distinctions: A. drummondii usually has 2–3 nearly one-veined spathe bracts and mostly flowers, bulbils rare. Nothoscordum lacks strong onion odor. Color and bulbil absence alone are insufficient.
